description: Read or correct the passport of a locker mesh (size, orientation, reference skeleton, colliders). `manual` merges a human correction (it always wins and survives regeneration); `clear` removes one. Measurements themselves come from gripforge_tool_run tool=passport.

clear.description: Remove one correction (orientation, joints.elbow.L, fits.helm) or "*" for all.

manual.description: Partial PassportManual to MERGE (e.g. {"orientation":{"up":[0,1,0],"front":[0,0,1],"toCanonical":[0,0,0,1],"confidence":1,"source":"manual"}}). Omit to read.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (defaults to the key’s workspace).

name: gripforge_mesh_passport
title: Studios · mesh passport
